name: Madeline Hotel & Residences, Auberge Collection
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out hotel and residences in Telluride's Mountain Village, run as Madeline Hotel & Residences, Auberge Collection
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access at the base of Telluride Ski Resort
Travelers who want a complimentary gondola link into the town of Telluride

facts.text: The hotel is at 568 Mountain Village Boulevard in Telluride's Mountain Village, surrounded by the San Juan Mountains.
Telluride Regional Airport is approximately 15 minutes from the hotel.
Black Iron Kitchen + Bar serves casual modern mountain cuisine around signature fire-tables.
Black Iron Kitchen + Bar has covered, heated outdoor dining.
Timber Room is a bar serving cocktails and shareable fare.
Kettle is a coffee shop within the hotel.
The Spa at Madeline offers nature-inspired therapies created by its therapists.
The hotel has a fitness center.
Local Adventure Guides can help with lift tickets, equipment rentals and ski or snowboard lessons.
Crest Club member amenities include year-round ski storage.

highlights.text: The hotel has ski-in/ski-out access at the base of Telluride Ski Resort, with a full-service ski valet.
A complimentary gondola connects the hotel to the historic town of Telluride.
The Alpine Swim Club has a heated outdoor pool, two hot tubs and a sundeck with views of the San Juan Mountains.
The Crest Club is a private slopeside club at the hotel for members.

considerations.text: The hotel routinely closes for periods in spring and fall, while the residences remain available.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the mountain resort location.
WhataHotel notes seasonal accessibility depends on mountain weather conditions.
